lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of approximately 12 visible vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs is present posterior to the gill slits, with roughly 4 to 6 blobs per column in the mid-lateral section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with faint longitudinal horizontal bands, forming a coordinate-like grid where the high-luminance blobs are localized at the nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp intensity transition from high-luminance upper edges to shadowed lower margins.

other_distinctive_markers: A small, elongated high-luminance feature is visible on the dorsal midline immediately posterior to the first dorsal fin base, consistent with the position of a trailing remora.
